conviction_note: No forecast revision was filed before the print and no fact found that the market lacks; the small positive lean comes from the habitual DPU beat (5 of 5 periods), an optional buyback at P/NAV about 0.82 with a precedent (+2.65% on the April 2025 print that carried one) and the sponsor's ongoing ¥5bn bid, offset slightly by the risk that the first 46th-period (Aug 2027) guide falls short of management's public 'EPU 4,000 = DPU 4,000' target. The findings sum to +0.45 and the scaled number is +0.15 (p_up 57 x abs 1.1). They differ because the buyback finding is an expected value over a payoff that probably does not happen, while p_up only leans modestly.
bar: 44th-period (Aug 2026) DPU forecast ¥4,000 and 45th-period (Feb 2027) ¥4,000, both unrevised, from the 2026-02 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260415/140120260415504700.pdf). For the new 46th period (Aug 2027) the bar is management's published target 'EPU 4,000円 = DPU 4,000円' in the 43rd-period results presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260415/140120260415504749.pdf, p.5-6). There is no 四季報/IFIS consensus reachable for this J-REIT, so the company guide is the only sourced bar. print_vs_bar is an expected DPU beat of about ¥120 on ¥4,000.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-19: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, unchanged. 信用倍率 7.62 (margin long-heavy, broker scrape). No options, so no skew. 20-day run-up -5.11% is sector beta: the TSE REIT ETF 1343 fell from 1,923.5 (09-03) to 1,791.5 (10-20), -6.9%, against 8968's -5.0% over the same span (Yahoo chart, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8968.T and 1343.T), so the name has slightly outperformed its sector into the print. Sponsor 福岡地所 is buying in the market: 11.28% at 2026-05-14, 12.89% at 2026-09-08 (変更報告書 No.13).

findings.finding: Fukuoka REIT has beaten its own DPU forecast in each of the last five periods (+¥52, +¥250, +¥196, +¥103, +¥151; the 43rd period came in at ¥4,151 against ¥4,000), and no 予想の修正 has been filed for the 44th period: TDnet shows only a head-office relocation notice in the 34 days to 10-20, and kabutan's disclosure list shows none since April. That points to a beat on the ¥4,000 forecast of roughly ¥100-150. Two facts trim it: the 2026-07-28 M7.1 Kumamoto quake caused only 'slight damage' to the Kumamoto assets by the company's own notice, and Chinese arrivals to Japan fell 56% in H1 2026, a risk to Canal City's variable rent. The April forecast was set with the China decline already visible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats of +¥151 (2026-04-15, released 15:30) and +¥103 (2025-10-17, 15:30) were followed by next-close moves of +1.40% and +0.10% (excess over 1343: +1.07 and -0.56). The beat is habitual and the second print shows it is not bought by itself.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: a beat is the expected pattern for this name, which is why it is sized small. What is not public is the size of the beat and how much of the Tenjin gain goes to 圧縮積立金 (¥252m guided). If the market had priced a miss, the name would have underperformed its sector into the print; it outperformed by about 1.9 points.
findings.independence: Earthquake notice: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729502119.pdf (2026-07-29, says no major impact). The China decline is from a separate source: https://toyokeizai.net/articles/-/951773. JCR (2026-07-15) also describes Canal City sales as strong: https://www.jcr.co.jp/download/71274d4dd7b62d310918dd7d488d863187dd3d49d3db3c780b/26d0195.pdf

findings.finding: This print gives the first DPU forecast for the 46th period (Mar-Aug 2027), the first period with no Tenjin North Front disposal gain (the final 16% tranche closes 2027-02-25). Management has publicly committed to 'EPU 4,000円 = DPU 4,000円' for that period. Its own bridge needs +¥445 of EPU growth from ¥3,555, of which +¥307 is called high-certainty and +¥91 medium. Refinancing costs are rising (guided interest ¥539m to ¥567m), and the REIT sector has sold off 6.9% in six weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-15, when the 45th guide was held at ¥4,000 and the EPU/DPU target framework was first published: +1.40% to the next close (+1.07 over the REIT ETF). 2025-10-17, a new-period guide with no capital return: +0.10% (-0.56 excess).
findings.why_not_priced: The target is public, so a 46th guide of ¥4,000 is in line and worth about 0. What is not priced is the sign of any deviation. The skew is slightly negative because the target reads '4,000 + α' only from the 46th period on, so upside is capped near ¥4,000 while a shortfall would visibly break a published commitment. Sized near zero because nothing found says which way it goes; it is a coin with a slightly fatter left tail, not a sourced shortfall.
findings.independence: none. The bridge, the target and the interest guide all come from the same company presentation and 短信.

findings.finding: A unit buyback announced with these results is a live option. The presentation names 自己投資口取得 under its equity strategy at a P/NAV of 0.93. The price is now ¥165,300 against a February NAV of ¥200,451 per unit, about 0.82x. A 16% Tenjin tranche of the ¥6,350m sale (about ¥1.0bn) was received on 2026-08-27. The 2025-04-16 results carried a ¥500m buyback, also funded by Tenjin proceeds, and the stock rose 2.65% the next day with the REIT ETF flat. The April 2026 results carried none.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-04-16 (15:30 release with a ¥500m buyback, 0.46% of units): +2.65% to the next close, ETF 0.00%. The only precedent.
findings.why_not_priced: A buyback is announced in the same TDnet batch and cannot be seen beforehand. The price has not run up into the print (-5.1% over 20 days, about in line with the sector), so no premium for one is visible. Sized as an expected value of roughly 30% x 2.5 points, not as a forecast that one comes. The sponsor's own ¥5bn programme may make the REIT less inclined to spend its own cash, which is part of why the probability is put at only about 30%.
findings.independence: Disposal completion and proceeds: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260827/140120260827527145.pdf (2026-08-27). NAV, P/NAV and the equity-strategy slide are in the 43rd presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260415/140120260415504749.pdf), a different document from the 2025 buyback notice.

findings.finding: The sponsor 福岡地所 is running a market purchase programme of up to ¥5bn on 8968 units from 2026-05-15 to 2027-05-14. Its stake rose from 11.28% (98,014 units) to 12.89% by 2026-09-08, about half the budget in four months. That is roughly ¥20m a day of standing demand against ¥225m median daily turnover, a cushion under any post-print selling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has yet fallen inside the programme's buying period with a negative surprise, so no reaction history exists. The 2026-05-14 announcement itself fell outside any earnings window.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since May, so the level is priced. What matters for this window is the flow: a standing buyer absorbs a margin-long overhang (信用倍率 7.62) if holders sell the news. Sized tiny for that reason.
findings.independence: Large-holding change report, kabutan summary: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8968&b=n202609150320 (filed 2026-09-15, 11.87% to 12.89%).

outside_window.finding: The final 16% Tenjin North Front tranche (gain ¥648m guided for the 45th period) closes 2027-02-25, and after it the DPU must stand on EPU alone. Whether the target EPU of ¥4,000 is actually reached is only known at the August 2027 period.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet I_list pages 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-20 for code 89680: one disclosure only (head office relocation, 2026-09-28 18:00). No 予想の修正, no buyback, no acquisition.
kabutan disclosure list since April 2026: no forecast revision for the 44th period; the only items are financing, earthquake, DBJ certification, the Tenjin tranche and the sponsor purchase.
No consensus or 四季報 DPU forecast for 8968 was reachable (kabuhai-db shows only the company plan; the irbank dps page returned 404).
Canal City Hakata 2026 sales data: no monthly series found. The only signals are an inbound-ranking piece (honichi 2026-06-23) and the national China decline.
8968 price action against the REIT ETF: the drawdown is sector-wide, with no idiosyncratic cause found.
Earthquake follow-up: no second notice of damage found after 2026-07-29.
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8968&nmode=3 (the 決算短信 was stamped 15:30 on 2025-04-16, 2025-10-17 and 2026-04-15)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed before the print. The 45th-period ¥4,000 may be held or nudged up, and a first 46th-period guide comes against the public ¥4,000 EPU=DPU target. Returns: a buyback is possible (precedent April 2025, P/NAV about 0.82, about ¥1bn of Tenjin cash); no 増配 mechanism beyond the DPU itself. New-year guide: the 46th-period DPU is the main item. Quarter: the 44th-period DPU against ¥4,000, beaten by ¥52 to ¥250 in each of the last five periods.

baseline_tension: priced_lean_pct is -0.185, driven by margin overhang (信用倍率 7.62) and partly offset by the run-up term. My small positive lean cuts mildly against that. The strongest positive this release could carry is a buyback alongside a held ¥4,000 46th guide; I looked for it and sized it as an expected value. The run-up is sector beta, not a name-specific drawdown, so it is not evidence of an over-reaction to buy back.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative on a public 月次/進捗率 series) does not apply because no finding rests on a visible miss. Rule 2 (check the strongest positive) was already done: the buyback and a held guide were searched for and filed. The one negative (-0.1, 46th-period guide) is a near-zero tail asymmetry, not a visible-miss call.
